Oh, walking along with an adventurer reminds me\nof my days in the human world... What? Yes, I was\npeddling all over the world in my early days.
After I got married, I was running a general store\nat the town called Bailune, but I didn't like to\nsettle down.
I left the general store to my wife and wandered\nmany places to find rare goods... Well, I admit\nI was too selfish when I think about it now.
...Huh? My wife? She's resting at the Garden of\nBeginning, so I sometimes call her and meet her.\nIt's allowed as a kind of privilege of choremen.
Oh? You need something? I don't really have a\nvariety of goods, so you may not be able to find\nthe ones you want. Would you like to see them?
Fida's General Store
Thanks.\nTell me anytime when you need something.
Fida's Storage
Whoaaa!! ...Oh, you scared me. You're a human.\nI thought it was a mutant soldier...\nOh? Why are you in human form?
Humans are supposed to come to this place in\nthe form of souls... What? Grecia saved and\nbrought you to here? What a rare case...
But the guy also looks like a human...
I'm in the form of humans, you say?\nThat's because I'm a choreman in this garden.\nYes, Dunkelis assigned me to do it.
...Oh, I'm Fida, by the way.\nI was a peddler when I was in the human world.\nNice to meet you...
By the way, why did you fall from above?\nEches threw you away? How violent...\nHuh? It's not the Cradle of Soldiers.
It's called the Garden of Beginning here and souls\nreturning from the world beyond rest here until\nthey are born again...
What?! Did it really happened to Dunkelis?!\nSo, you're going to save her...\nThe way to the Cradle of Soldiers?
Hmm, I know how to get there but I can't tell you\nwithout permission... And Varcene who's in charge\nof managing this place isn't here now...
Oh, you came here just now. No wonder you don't\nknow him. This place is managed by Varcene the\ndeputy of Dunkelis.
He was seriously wounded during the first attack\nof the soldiers corroded by the black crystals.\nHe's healing the wounds at another place.
For now, let's ask Burnos the Dark Captain of\nFire. He's currently the guard of here.
He should be at the Spiring of Rebirth, which lies\nat the center of this place.\nI'll guide you there.

But, you're quite young...\nOops, sorry, so you're not dead yet.
I was a researcher when I was alive. I can't help\nbut feel like there were really only a few things\nin life that made sense to me...
Therefore, I asked the Goddess of Darkness to\nallow me to use the stuff here and continue my\nresearch on the unknowns.
If you have questions or anything you want me to\ninvestigate, I'll apply my full knowledge to\nresearch them and give you the answer.
...I was doing research in pharmacy when I was\nalive. Now I'm investigating the situation\noccurring here in the Dark Realm.
Especially the cause of the knights and fighters'\nsudden mutation...I think I can find the cause if\nthere are some samples here...
So, 10 Corroded Huge Arms, 10 Corroded Spears, and\n10 Corroded Beast Nails would be enough for me to\nconduct an experiment.
But since I'm a researcher, I'm powerless.\nSo, please. Will you collect them for me?
Okay!
No way!
Wow, thank you! Of course, there will be a reward\nfor you. I'll be waiting for you.
Oh, that's too bad...Fine, I won't force you, but\nplease let me know when you have the chance to\ndo it...
W-wow, thank you! This is more than enough!\nYes, yes, yes, experiment, experimenttt!
...Ahem, with this I can do some research to find\nthe cure. All right, here's your reward.
Someone who came to the Dark Realm alive is indeed\nan interesting subject for research...How did you\ndo that?
Oh, I'm sorry. Actually, there's not enough water\nfor the experiment. Fresh and clean water is\nindispensable for the experiment.
Will you bring me some water? 10 Clean Water would\nbe enough...Of course, I'll reward you.
All right!
Lemme think about it.
Wow, thank you!\nThen please, the faster, the better!
You can get the water from a place called the\nSpring of Rebirth. Thanks in advance!
Oh, really...\nOkay, please lemme know when you have the chance\nto do it.
Thank you! We need the water for various things\nincluding dilution and washing.
Well, I never expected that I would be troubled by\nan experiment after I died. A satisfactory\nexperiment that quite makes sense is really rare...
It's good that I don't need to eat now, so I can\nfocus on doing experiments. But if there's no\nexperiment for me to do, I will die...
Experiment is my goal! Experiment is my life!\nExperiment is the reason I'm here!!...Oh, I'm\nsorry. Well, this is your reward.
Hmm...oh, if it's you, it should be...\nSo, I'm conducting a very important experiment now.
I can't continue my experiment because I heard\nsomething that bothers me. I heard some atrocious\nmonsters are going on a rampage near Dark Mirror...
It'll hinder the experiment if something happens to\nDark Mirror. It's still okay now, but please,\nit would be great if you can eliminate the risk.
Seems like it'll be fine if you could kill\n25 Heat Puffers and 25 Sunions...
I don't think it would be easy, but please.
I'll try!
It's troublesome!
Wow, thanks! Show them who we really are! Massacre\nthose monsters that hinder my experiment...\n*cough cough
Anyway, please get rid of them so that I can\ncontinue my research in peace.
Oh really...I'll have to think of another way\nthen...Asking for your help is the best way,\nthough...
Thank you! They're just unforgivable pests that\ndon't even deserve to be my experimental subjects!!
......Oh, nothing. Now I can do my research\nat ease. All right, this is your reward.
Excuse me, have you got a minute? I'm investigating\nthe knights and the fighters' sudden mutation and\nsome crystal monsters have been detected.
Based on my analysis, they're probably the main\nculprits that are infesting the fighters...\nWe should do something about it.
It'd be great if you could kill 30 of them.\nThat should stop them from giving us trouble\nfor a while.
I got it!
Maybe next time!
Thank you!\nOf course, I'll prepare a decent reward for you!
That's too bad.\nPlease lemme know when you wanna do it.
Ooh, you slayed them?!\nThen for now...*muttering, if there are no new\ncorroded...*muttering.
And if my hypothesis is correct...\nOh, I'm sorry. All right, your reward.
Please listen to me for a minute!\nActually, I'm experimenting, *ahem researching for\nthe cure for those infested.
And I found some effective cures.\nAt least, they work on my current experimental\nsubje...I mean, patients.
But then, I have way too few ingredients and I'm sure\nthey won't be enough...I wanna help them and I need\nyou to collect the ingredients for the medicine.
I want you to collect 10 Stimulants and\n1 Darkness Mushroom. Is it okay?
Of course!
No way!
Wow, thanks a lot! This way I can make\nmore progress with my experiment...*ahem ahem,\nresearch.
Oh really...it can't be helped...\nPlease cooperate with me when you have time.
Thank you! I can now save them...but then I won't\nbe able to do experiment on them anymore...
They are very interesting subjects and I had a\nvery hard time studying them! Hmm...I'm kinda\nreluctant to let them go.
...Oh, no. What am I saying! Curing them is my\npriority! I can simply find new experimental\nsubjects later, right...?
By the way, if you don't mind, I'd like you to\nhelp me with my next experime...I mean research.
Oh, it's okay if you don't want to.\nHere's your reward.\nIt's okay if you don't want, though.
Hmm, I'm in trouble...\nOh, the right person at the right time!
Please listen. Actually, the Magic Books that are\nin charge of the research materials suddenly went\nwild.
And one of them is the book where important\nconclusion regarding what happened this time was\ndocumented. We can't let them mess it up.
I'll be happy if you could calm those Magic Books\ndown...
Roger that!
Sorry, got stuff to do...
Sorry to say this, but every minute counts!\nPlease hurry!
That's too bad. But if you change your mind,\nplease deal with those books.
Thank you! For God's sake, finally they settled\ndown! Who do they think they are! Insolent lifeless\nthings!
Hmm? But now I'm also lifeless?\nI'm somewhat a specter, not a living being at\nleast.
Oh, dear...Never expected such an interesting\nresearch subject to be this close to me...I must\nfinish my current research and start a new one...!
...Oh, oops! S-sorry.\nHere's your reward.
Got a minute?\nYou're the only person I can ask to deal with\nthis matter.
Actually, after researching it for a while, I begin\nto understand the substance that is the source of\ninfection and main cause of the infestation...
If I find out everything about it, finding wonder\ndrug won't be a mere dream. But I need something\nthat's more severely infested to confirm it.
So, I want you to go to a more severely infested\nplace and bring me some samples to be tested.\nIt's dangerous, but I know you'll be fine...
Yeah, I want you to bring 30 Dully Glowing Stones\nand 10 Strange Essences for me...
I'll do it.
Sorry, I can't.
Thank you! This way, I may be able to cure those\nwho are badly infested!
I-it can't be helped...\nPlease lemme know when you have the chance to\ndo it.
You've brought them here?\nHurry up, lemme see 'em, give 'em to me, lemme\ntouch 'em!
I-I'm sorry...but this also means that the analysis\nis complete. Just wait for it and hope for the\nbest!
Once it's done, I can start my new experiment!\nMoreover, the subject is myself, so no one would\ncomplain about it!
Oooh, I'm so pumped up!\nI've never felt like this before even when I was\nalive back then...
Whoops...Almost forgot.\nHere's your reward.
Oh, it's you...I have bad news for you.\nThanks to you, I found out about the cause and\ndiscovered the cure for the infested, but
it only cures those in the initial stage of\ninfection. Those who have been badly infested are\nincurable.
The corrosion is similar to decomposition...We can\nremove and cure it if it's not too bad, but if the\nwhole body has been gnawed, nothing can be done.
As a researcher, I can't just leave it like this\nand let the infection spread.
The knights and fighters that have been badly\ninfested are found in Dark Castle...\nPlease, free them from the infestation.
Let's do this!
I'm sorry...
...Thank you so much. I'm sorry for pushing you to\nperform such an unpleasant duty...
I knew you'd be unwilling to do it...\nBut, we really need to do this before we see more\nvictims...
...Thank you very much. At least this way, we have\nprevented the possibility of the infection from\nspreading.
I know it must have been hard for you too.\nI'm okay, don't worry about me. Since I'm a\nresearcher, I know things like this would happen.
Research is a cruel thing. There are times when\nyou're the first one to know that there's nothing\nyou can do about something.
...The fact that I wasn't able to save them won't\nchange. But, I'll make sure that the result of this\nresearch will be useful in the future.
That's the role of researchers, that's our duty.\nWell, this is your reward.

Seeing you reminds me of my lifetime...My life in\nSofya City as a member of the noble family that\nhas been around for many generations...
Although not living in luxury, I was happy back\nthen as I met a nice husband, blessed with a\ndaughter, and had a comfortable life.
I want the same kind of life in my next life.\nBut before it begins, I'd like to live here just\nlike when I was alive...
You don't think it's okay to be attached to this\nlife as we'll be put into sleep and have to forget\neverything before the next life begins anyway?
Oh, how rude! Ugh, it angers me just to think\nabout it! Arghh!! Oh, ah...*ahem, I'm so sorry.\nI was slightly irritated...
Eh? You asked me what happened? Thanks. Actually,\nthe Goddess of Darkness gave me permission to\nstroll around the Spring of Rebirth.
That place reminds me of the plants in the mansion\nI used to live in when I was alive, so I tend it\nwhenever I go...
But after tending it today, suddenly a flock of\ncute weirdos came to peck and pull the plants...\nI can never forgive them! Arghhh!!
Oh, ah, sorry about that...Oh right, you!\nI want my revenge. Will you exterminate those\ncute weirdos for me?
I can't prepare a reward like the one I used to\nprepare when I was alive, but I'll reward you\nas much as possible, so please...
Agree.
Refuse.
Thank you! How do they look like? The body is round\nand there are long things like fringes that grow\nfrom the top and the side of their head.
They have round and cute eyes with a small but\nsharp beak. It hurts like hell if you get pecked!\n...Oh, ah, I'm sorry again...
A-anyway, please kill around 50 of them.\nI'll have your reward ready before you come back.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
You're back already?! I suppose it's a little bit\ntoo fast... Whoaaa... What?! You really did it...\nOMG... Oops, incredible...
I appreciate it. Now I can walk around the\nSpring of Rebirth and prune plants safe.
So, here you are. Please take it.\nI sincerely appreciate your help.\nI hope you can do me a favor again.
Hmm, what to do... Hm? Whoa?! Who's there?!\n...Ah, don't scare me... Well, sorry.\nI was thinking about something...
Oh? You can listen to me? Thanks. Actually,\nI often walk around the Spring of Rebirth\nunder the permission of the Goddess of Darkness.
When I was taking a walk today, I found something\nglittering in the plants... I picked up this.\nLook, it's a huge gemstone.
I was not really interested in gemstones when\nI lived as an aristocrat but this reminds me of\nthe desire to possess...
So, the point is, it seems like there are more\nhuge gemstones at the Spring of Rebirth.\nCould you collect them for me?
I can't reward you like when I used to be an\naristocrat but I'll do my best to give you\nsomething good... So, please.
Okay.
Nope.
Oh, you can do it for me?! Thank you so much!\nI heard it from Mr. Fida that the monsters at\nthe Spring of Rebirth has the huge gemstones.
...Yes, sorry I should have told you about it\nfirst. You need to hunt monsters to get the\ngemstones. Is that okay?! You're so reliable!!
A-Anyway, I'll prepare rewards for you before\nyou come back. Thanks in advance.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
You're back already? Isn't that too fast...\nOh... Whoa?! You've got the gemstones...\nOMG... Oops, awesome.
Thanks for everything. I completely remember\nmy desire to possess. Hee hee...\nNow what should I do with these gemstones...
Mrs. Dianne, you are allowed to walk around but\nyou are not allowed to possess things in the\nDark Realm.
Oh! Dunkelis?! Oh my god...Ah, umm, I'm\njust...er, oh, nope, uh, umm...
If you keep them, she'll make you sleep and\nforget everything. I guess you should return\nthem all and take a walk freely, right?
Ugh... God da... Oops, you're right...\nI understood, I'll return them all!
In the next moment, the gemstones in front of her\nemit light and disappeared...
This place is for the souls to rest in peace,\nclear all the desire and prepare for the next\nlife. You should keep it in mind.
Gosh... Oops, well...\nI'm sorry I wasted your effort...
But I agree that it's not a good thing to have\ndesire in the Dark Realm as Dunkelis says.\nI think I should cool down for a while...
Now, please take this... It's okay you've done\ngreat job. It's for you.\nPlease help me out again.
*sigh* What should I do... Oh?\nExcuse me, I was just thinking about something...
You know, I've been working on pruning plants here\nand at the Spring of Rebirth but sometimes\nI remember the days when I was alive.
Now that I'm a ghost, I don't need an elegant\nmansion and gorgeous outfits... But I feel like\nthe life in here is kind of tasteless...
I guess the life when I was alive still fits me.\nSo, first of all, I'd like to build a mansion\non this vast land...
I got stuck when I realize that I have to get\nthe materials to build the mansion... Hm?\nOh, yes! Can you collect them for me?
You look like you can do it easily, right?
I can't reward you like when I used to be an\naristocrat but I'll do my best to give you\nsomething good... You can do it for me, right?
I'll do it.
I can't!
Thank you! So, I want you to collect Stone of\nSublimation... How many?\nWell, 30 should be enough.
Oh, now I remembered that you need to defeat\nmonsters to get Stone of Sublimation.\nPlease be careful.
I'll get the rewards for you before you come back.\nThanks in advance.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
You're back already? Isn't that too fast...\nOh... Whoa?! You've got the stones...\nOMG... Oops, awesome.
I appreciate it. Now I can build the mansion.\nWhat? ...Don't worry about that. There's a soul\nwho used to be an architect resting at the garden.
Oh? Mrs. Dianne.\nWhat are you gonna do with the stone?
Oops... There he comes...\nUm, ah... You know.\nI'm just gonna make some flower beds and...
Oh yea? But you can't do it without permission\nfrom Dunkelis. If you arrange the garden,\nBurnos will be really upset.
Whaaat?! ...Oh, no...\nOkay, I'll give up this time.
Smart decision.\nWell, please clear up the stones.
Dam... Oh, excuse me...\nI'm sorry it ended up wasting time...
I'll just hide the stones and wait for the chance.\nI'm never gonna give up!\nI swear I'll build a big mansion some day!!
Now, here you are... You worked a lot for me.\nPlease don't hold back.\nI'll ask you a favor again.
Hmm, how can I... Hm? Whoa?! Who's there?!\n...Ah, don't scare me... Well, sorry.\nI was thinking about something...
Oh, you're gonna listen to me?\nThank you. Actually, I often go take a walk to\nthe Dark River with the permission of the goddess.
I was walking around there yesterday and I found\na really pretty bunny! But the bunny ran away\nas soon as it saw me.
I wanna keep it as a pet but I'm just a feeble\nghost. There's no way I can catch it...\nThat's what I was thinking about...
Oh, yes! Can you bring the bunny to me?\nIt's for me so only the soul will be fine...
I can't reward you like when I used to be an\naristocrat but I'll do my best to give you\nsomething good... So, please.
Okay.
No way!
You can do that for me?! Thank you! ...Where\ndid you see, you ask? I think it's the Trace\nof Dark River. There're many monsters though.
...Yea, the bunny should be among the monsters.\nIt's so cute so you won't miss it.
I'll get the rewards for you before you come back.\nThanks in advance.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
You're back already?! I suppose it's a little bit\ntoo fast... Whoaaa... What?! It's the bunny's soul!
Now here you are... This is my token of gratitude.\nPlease take it. Maybe I'll ask you a favor, so\nhelp me out again.
It's been a while since I had a pet...\nO-Oh? What's wrong with you? Ah!\nWhere are you goin'?! Wait!
Adventurer, did you see something around here?\nI'm in charge of managing the land, so I can\nsense monsters coming here.
I just felt there's a monster around here...\nWhat? No? Hmm, maybe just my imagination then?
The bunny ghost ran away because Fida noticed?\nLet's hope it won't cause any trouble...
*sigh* That girl is always... Oh?\nExcuse me. I've got a little trouble...
It's about my daughter who is still alive...\nShe seems like she's beaten by the rival...\nThat causes me headache.
It seems like she has no chance to win, so I'd\nlike to give her some support somehow...\nCan you help me out?
I'll cast curse to the rival so my daughter can\nattack off guard and win!!
So, what I want is the material to make curse.\nNow that you know my plan, you can't say no.
I can't reward you like when I was alive but\nI'll do my best to give you something good...\nYou can do it for me, right?
Alright.
I'm busy...
I appreciate it!\nSo, please collect Grudge of Soldier...\nHow many? As many as you can...
Oh, come to think of it, you need to defeat\nthe controlled soldiers. Please be careful.
I'll get the rewards for you before you come back.\nThanks in advance.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
You're back already?! I suppose it's a little bit\ntoo fast... Whoaaa... What?! You really did it...\nOMG... Oops, incredible...
Thank you. Now I can send the curse to her.\nI've gotta get ready for...
Mrs. Dianne, I feel something incredibly sinister\nand ominous around here. Are you alright?
Whoa! Sh... O-Oh, excuse me...\nI-It's nothing. It should be your imagination.
Oh, yea? The energy is too strong so I'm not sure\nif Burnos can handle alone.
So, I was thinking of asking Sir Halios or\nVatendeth the Dark General for help.
Whoa! Really?! That's horrible!\n...Oops. I-It's really nothing!\nYou're just taking it too serious!!
I got it. Tell me if you find something wrong.\nI'll call Sir Halios right away.
Whooa... That was close...\nI'm sorry... Your effort went in vain...
Even if it's for my daughter, curse is curse.\nI shouldn't use it at the sacred place...\nI think I should cool down for a while...
Now, please take this... It's okay you've done\ngreat job. It's for you.\nPlease help me out again.
*sigh* How can I do this... Oh?\nUm, excuse me. I was thinking about something.
Have you heard of Jelly Beans?\nIt's a kind of sweets that are shaped like a thin\nlong colorful beans and I really like it!
I'm a ghost so I'm not supposed to have appetite\nbut sometimes I really wanna have Jelly Beans.\nMaybe because I still wanna live like before.
So, since when I heard that I can have Jelly Beans\nin this world, I just can't help it.
But I heard they are in a dangerous place...\nOh, yes! Can you collect Jelly Beans for me?
You seem like you're skilled.\nIt should be a piece of cake for you to\ncollect Jelly Beans, right?
I can't prepare a reward like the one I used to\nprepare when I was alive, but I'll reward you\nas much as possible, so please...
Leave it to me.
I can't!
Thanks for accepting my request!\nI'm counting on you... How many?\nWell, 30 should be okay...
What? Where to get?\nIt should be like soft places like Jelly Beans\nI guess. I have no idea...
People say they are in a scary place,\nso be careful. I'll get you rewards before you\ncome back here.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
Was it kind of hard for you? It took a little bit\nlong... Whoa... But there are as many Jelly Beans\nas I asked. Awesome!
I appreciate it. Oh wow!\nI've never imagined I can eat Jelly Beans here\nagain! Now let's...
Adventurer.\nDid you have something when you came back?
...What? Jelly Beans?!\n...D-Don't say you ate them!\nYou can't!!
S-Schwhaaat?! Oops...\nW-Why is that?!?!
The shape and taste are same as the Jelly Beans\nbut when the soul of a researcher looked into them,\nhe found out they're living tissues.
They're not really poisonous but he's still\nanalyzing them, so you shouldn't eat them.
Oh gosh... T-Then I'll just leave them.\nBut are you serious... God da... Oops.
Well, it's weird that Jelly Beans exist here...\nI'm so sorry for asking such a thing...
Now, please take this... It's okay you've done\ngreat job. It's for you.\nPlease help me out again.
Okay, it's going well... Whoa?!\nYou scared me! It's you...\nAhem, sorry about that.
You know, since I'm a ghost, I don't need a\nmansion or outfits. But to change my tasteless\nlife here, I started building a mansion!
I did anything I could do to get the building\nmaterials, and asked other souls for help.\nBut...
The interior looks too poor as it is, so\nI need the materials to decorate...\nOh, yes! Can you collect them for me?
You look skilled, so it should be super easy\nto collect the materials, right?
I can't prepare a reward like the one I used to\nprepare when I was alive, but I'll reward you\nas much as possible, so please...
I'll do it.
Sorry, I can't.
Thanks for accepting my request!\nNow please collect Cracked Platinum Armguard...\nHow many? As many as possible...
Oh, now I remembered that you need to defeat\nthe soldiers at the Dark Castle who are controlled\nby the crystals to get Cracked Platinum Armguard.
Even though they are being controlled, is it\nalright to defeat the soldiers in the castle...?
They're soldiers but they just act like\nferocious monsters. You can't just watch them\noccupy the Dark Castle, right?
I'll get the rewards for you before you come back.\nThanks in advance.
What did you saaaay?! How dare you...\nOh, oh. Excuse me again... tee hee!
I understood you're busy.\nIt would be nice if you could help me out when\nyou are free... Thank you.
Was it kind of hard for you? It took a little bit\nlong... Whoa... But there are as many materials\nas I asked. Awesome!
I appreciate it. Now I can make decorations.\nWhat? ...No worries. One of the souls in the\nGarden of Beginning used to be a chaser...
Mrs. Dianne, I'm afraid to tell you this but\neven if you build something, it will disappear\nimmediately without Dunkelis' permission.
Schwhaaat?! Oops..\nI-Is that true?!\nSo, now I've gotta get permission from...
Well, even if Dunkelis gave you permission,\nSir Burnos will be upset saying [Souls don't need\na big mansion!]
In the worst case, Sir Burnos may remove all\nthe rights you've got from Dunkelis and you might\nhave to rest and forget everything. Is that okay?
Oh, come on...! Oops...\nI understood. I'll give it up!
That's good for you. You should clear up the desire\nthat you had in the previous life and prepare for\nthe next life.
Gosh... Oops, well...\nI'm sorry I wasted your effort...
...I wanted to live like I used to but that's not\nthe only reason that I decided to build this\nmansion...
The girl in Sofya City...\nNot sure whom she resembled but she's so\nself-centered and look down everyone...
I don't wanna meet her yet but some time when she\ncomes to this world, I wanted her to live like\nbefore...
The way she talks is similar to someone but...\nThe girl is maybe...
My daughter's name?\nShe's Lefina.
I'll cool down for a while...\nNow, please take it... Don't hold back.\nYou worked a lot for me.
I sincerely appreciate your help.\nPlease help me out again when I'm in trouble.
